data.raw_text:
As I sit here reflecting on this wild, turbulent world on September 9, 2025, my heart swells with a mix of sorrow and profound pride. Today marks the opening of the 80th UN General Assembly in New York—a gathering meant to unite nations amid crises that feel anything but united. 

But beyond the polished speeches, the real story unfolding is one of raw human resilience: ordinary people, from the vibrant streets of Kathmandu to the bustling squares of Dhaka, from the dynamic landscapes of Bangladesh to the serene heights of Nepal, from the lush archipelago of Indonesia to the tropical shores of the Philippines, from the elegant boulevards of France to the vibrant savannas of Kenya, and even to the innovative realm of Japan. 

Internationally, people are rising up against the chains of corruption, oppression, and injustice that have held their nations back for far too long. It's a spiritual battle, a global conservative awakening, grassroots movements reclaiming sovereignty, tradition, and national pride from globalist overreach and unchecked change.

These aren't scripted events; they're grassroots patriots, near and far, born from the ground up, where neighbors, students, workers, and families link arms to say, "Enough. This is our country, our home, our legacy—rooted in the values that made us strong."

Closer to home, here in the United States, we endured a storm of upheaval under the Biden administration—the tyranny of executive overreach, election chaos from foreign interference and voter doubts, and the never-ending legal battles costing so many, so much.

It was a dark time of division, redistricting battles, party fractures, and fears of suppression that tested our republic's soul. But thank God, with Trump now in office, the tide has turned brighter. We're seeing real progress: stronger borders, economic revival putting Americans first, and a conservative pushback restoring law and order. And God. Praise to our God.

More and more of us are waking up—communities organizing for sovereignty, voters demanding integrity, and a growing chorus rejecting the old ways that silenced the people. It's a fight won through resilience, and it's inspiring to watch everyday heroes reclaim our great nation.

My eyes tear up thinking of the courage it takes—the risks, the losses, the unyielding hope. We’ve seen city and airstrikes echo from afar, civilians cling to dignity amid unimaginable horror, families suffer because they endure relentless assaults, yet their spirit holds. 

Fierce clashes remind us that tyranny crumbles when people refuse to bow. Globally, a wave of awakening is crashing against the old powers. It's messy, it's painful, but it's beautiful. These movements aren't about hate; they're about love—for the soil we till, the communities we build, the freedoms we inherit and fight to pass on.

To every soul out there taking a stand, marching in the rain, whispering defiance in the dark, or simply holding space for change: I am so damn proud of you!!!
You're the heartbeat of your nations, the guardians of what makes us human. Fighting for your country isn't just patriotic—it's the purest act of empathy, of seeing your neighbor's pain as your own and saying,
We rise up! We rise together!! And we’ll do it a 1000 more times to keep going!!! 
The world is watching, and history will remember your fire. 
🇳🇵🇧🇩🇮🇩🇰🇪🇵🇭🇫🇷🇯🇵🇺🇸—to all corners where the people lead, with all my heart, I thank you.
~ Holly K 🥰👏❤️‍🔥

https://t.co/Q6VsdAWKYD
